args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring (and FIN-212)
specifies banker's rounding. Update the rounding mode so cents round
half-to-even (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66, 2.675 -> 2.68).

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`:

`src/money.py::round_money` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 (and the existing docstring) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` to return `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switch the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI (run `ci-0001`, commit 08d3cd5986) passed on branch `fix/fin-212-round-half-even`, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
